title: n_params_anacon=-1 makes the GW window hypersensitive to nfreq; pin n_params_anacon=6
symptom: Frequency convergence runs non-monotonically: 16->24 window changes 0.177 eV, 24->32 changes 0.350 eV with ~90 eV root switches on high states; fixing nfreq=12 does not help.
root_cause: The default n_params_anacon=-1 (use all frequencies for Pade) couples the continuation order to the frequency grid, so changing nfreq changes the continuation itself; two definition axes moved at once.
minimal_fix: Pin n_params_anacon=6 (with minimax grids; OML v4+ contract) so frequency-grid convergence and continuation are decoupled; then measure 24->32 (window 0.04440 eV, gap 0.00021 eV PASS) and report deep-valence and high-state ranges separately.
validation: Documented BN numbers above; v4+ profiles enforce minimax + n_params_anacon=6 + option_qpe_solver=0.
avoid: Concluding 'nfreq converged' or 'not converged' from runs where the Pade order moved with nfreq; a converged gap is not a converged window.
